Constitution of The Islamic Republic of Pakistan 1973

CONSTITUTION OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF PAKISTAN, 1973
CONSTITUTION OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF PAKISTAN, 1973
(Constitution of Judicial Commission of Pakistan for appointment of
Judges)
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part III, 5th November, 2010]
No.F.1/52/2010-SCA.,
dated 4-11-2010.---In pursuance of sub-Article 2 of Article 175A of the
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, 1973, a Judicial Commission
of Pakistan, for appointment of Judges of the Supreme Court, Federal Shariat
Court and High Courts has been constituted, as under:
SUPREME COURT
OF PAKISTAN
1.
Chief Justice of
Pakistan
Chairman
2.
Senior most Judge,
Supreme Court of Pakistan
Member
3.
Next senior most
Judge, Supreme Court of Pakistan
Member
4.
Mr. Justice Ch. Ijaz
Ahmed, Former Judge, Supreme Court of Pakistan
Member (For two years)
5.
Federal Minister for
Law and Justice
Member
6.
Attorney-General for
Pakistan
Member
7.
Dr. A. Khalid Ranjha,
Senior Advocate, Member, Pakistan Bar Council
Member (For two
years).
FEDERAL
SHARIAT COURT
2. Under
sub-Article 7 of Article 175A of the Constitution, for appointment of Judges of
the Federal Shariat Court the Commission shall also include the following,
namely.
1.
Chief Justice, Federal
Shariat Court
Member
2.
Most senior Judge,
Federal Shariat Court
Member
3. Under
Sub-Article 5 of Article 175A of the Constitution, for appointment of Judges of
High Courts, the Commission shall also include the following namely:
LAHORE HIGH
COURT
1.
Chief Justice, Lahore
High Court
Member
2,
Most senior Judge,
Lahore High Court
Member
3.
Provincial Minister
for Law, Punjab
Member
4.
Rai Bashir Ahmad,
Member, Punjab Bar Council
Member (For two years)
Note: For
appointment of the Chief Justice of Lahore High Court, most senior Judge of
that Court shall be substituted by Mr. Justice Mian Allah Nawaz former Chief
Justice, Lahore High Court. This membership is for one-time only.
HIGH COURT OF
SINDH
1.
Chief Justice, High
Court of Sindh
Member
2.
Most senior Judge,
High Court of Sindh
Member
3.
Provincial Minister
for Law, Sindh
Member
4.
Mr. Yaseen Khan E.
Babar, Member, Sindh Bar Council
Member (For two years)
PESHAWAR HIGH COURT
1.
Chief Justice,
Peshawar High Court
Member
2.
Most senior Judge,
Peshawar High Court
Member
3.
Provincial Minister
for law, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Member
4.
Mr. Fazal-i-Haq
Abbasi, Advocate
Member (For two years)
HIGH COURT OF
BALOCHISTAN
1.
Chief Justice, High
Court of Balochistan
Member
2.
Most senior Judge,
'High Court of Balochistan
Member
3.
Provincial Minister
for Law, Balochistan
Member
4.
Mr. Muhammad Kamran
Mulakhail, Chairman, Executive Committee, Balochistan Bar Council
Member (For two years)
ISLAMABAD
HIGH COURT
4. Under
sub-Article (6) of Article 175A of the Constitution, for appointment of Judges
of the Islamabad High Court the Commission shall also include the following,
namely:
(i) Chief Justice of
the Islamabad High Court:
Member and
(ii) the most senior
Judge of that High Court:
Member
Provided that for
initial appointment of the Judges of the Islamabad High Court, the Chief
Justices of the Four Provincial High Courts shall also be members of the
Commission, i.e.
1.
Chief Justice, Lahore
High Court
Member
2.
Chief Justice, High
Court of Sindh
Member
3.
Chief Justice Peshawar
High Court
Member
4.
Chief Justice, High
Court of Balochistan
Member
Provided further
that subject to the foregoing proviso, in case of appointment of Chief Justice
of Islamabad High Court, the provisos to clause (5) shall, mutatis mutandis,
apply.
5. This issues with
the approval of the Hon'ble Chief Justice of Pakistan/Chairman, Judicial
Commission of Pakistan.
